name: start
js: const T={levels:{keep:18,wall:18,towers:18,barracks:12,lair:12},seed:11,ratio:1,power:4500,loot:{turq:60,emerald:60,ruby:60},tesla:0,emblem:'swords',name:'Navid'}; __bw.battle.start(T,null,null); for(let i=0;i<600;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(__bw.battle.session && !__bw.battle.loading) break; } const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.intro=0; const d=S.sim.deploy; return {dp:[d.x|0,d.z|0,d.nx.toFixed(2),d.nz.toFixed(2)], gate:S.sim.base.deploy&&1};

name: objs
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, d=S.sim.deploy, THREE=__bw.THREE; const out={}; const box=new THREE.Box3(), c=new THREE.Vector3(); __bw.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; let p=o, ok=true; while(p){ if(p.visible===false){ok=false;break;} p=p.parent;} if(!ok) return; if(o.isInstancedMesh){ return; } box.setFromObject(o); if(box.isEmpty()) return; box.getCenter(c); const dd=Math.hypot(c.x-d.x,c.z-d.z); if(dd>60) return; let top=o; while(top.parent && top.parent.type!=='Scene') top=top.parent; const k=(top.name||top.type)+'|'+(o.name||'')+'|'+(o.material&&o.material.color?o.material.color.getHexString():''); out[k]=(out[k]||0)+1; }); const ks=Object.keys(out).slice(0,45); return ks.map(k=>k+' x'+out[k]);
